[SWS_CM_99029] Service Contract Version
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00500
⌈
The value of the service contract major version (
serviceContractVersionMajor
)
shall be derived from the
majorVersion
attribute in the
ServiceInterface
. The
value of the service contract minor version (
serviceContractVersionMinor
) shall
be derived from the
minorVersion
attribute in the
ServiceInterface
.
⌋
The following data types are used for the handling of services on the service consumer
side.
